spec.name: move_only
spec.bug: a move changes only the highlight and the agent on screen stays, as fx did before this change

spec.name: search_stays
spec.bug: a search edit that hides the highlighted row moves the highlight without showing its agent

spec.name: up_stays
spec.bug: Up on the first row stays there instead of closing the list

spec.name: close_parent
spec.bug: a close of the agent on screen shows its instance or the next instance instead of the row above the closed agent

spec.name: back_stays
spec.bug: Esc keeps the agent shown instead of the agent the list opened on

spec.name: paste_back
spec.bug: a paste goes back to the agent the list opened on instead of keeping the agent shown

spec.name: stale_origin
spec.bug: the agent the list opened on stays the one Esc goes back to after it closed

spec.name: enter_noop
spec.bug: Enter closes the list without showing the highlighted row

spec.name: open_first
spec.bug: the list opens on its first row instead of the agent on screen

spec.name: row
spec.bug: the highlight stays on its row, not its agent, when the rows change

spec.name: stale_sel
spec.bug: the highlight stays on an agent that closed

spec.name: run_closes
spec.bug: a run of Backspace or Delete presses that edited the search goes on, once the search is empty, to arm and close the highlighted row, as fx did before the run
